pages.text: Mix three morning-glory flowers or seeds, a water bucket and an empty compatible vessel. The recipe yields up to 500 mB. Transfer to a flask for collection or a distillery for concentration.
For belladonna or jimsonweed extract, use three seeds of that one species with a water bucket and vessel. Use a mod bottle for the full 500 mB and keep the species separate.

pages.title: Concentrate
pages.text: Run an extract through the $(l:psychedelicraft:processing/distilling)distillery$(/l) and collect the 1 mB portions in the receiver. Run the first-pass output again for stage two. Every pass halves the available volume.
Craft paper with a drink vessel containing stage-two morning-glory extract. The recipe uses 1 mB and returns the vessel. The LSA square and the dealer’s LSD pill both add the LSD profile.

pages.title: Serve or Dose
pages.text: Use a compatible drink vessel for flower extracts. A 10 mB syringe also accepts morning-glory extract. Belladonna and jimsonweed add $(l:psychedelicraft:effects/atropine)atropine$(/l). Morning-glory extract adds $(l:psychedelicraft:effects/lsd)LSD$(/l).
